decisions.reason: Because it survived the first review period and fits closely with the firm’s core cheese business in a growing market, management would likely keep it unless recent sales clearly fell below aspiration levels.

As a multi-variant spicy cheese line with its own page in 2019, it appears to have earned a stronger position in the portfolio, so boundedly rational management would be inclined to continue it barring clear underperformance.

This mild soft cheese is adjacent to established capabilities and remained actively presented after launch, so with no visible sign of failure the firm would probably retain it while monitoring whether it continues to justify shelf space and resources.
